item.title: Kong Launches Volcano Cloud Platform Built for AI Agents
item.description:
Kong has released Volcano, a cloud platform purpose-built for AI agents, bundling hosting, Postgres, authentication, storage, sandboxes and long-running workflows so agents built with Claude Code, Cursor or Codex can be deployed directly. Its centerpiece LavaFlow monitors the live app and codebase, diagnoses failures and submits fixes via GitHub, enabling self-healing operations. The platform targets agent workloads that run for hours, wait on humans or fail midway, which conventional request-oriented hosting handles poorly.

原文标题：Kong 推出 Volcano 智能体云平台

Why it matters：Kong 将智能体长时运行与自愈修复能力打包为云基础设施，代表托管范式从请求级向智能体级的迁移。

item.title: Nvidia Stock Plunges 40 Percent Despite Blockbuster Q3 Earnings
item.description:
Nvidia posted Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion, more than doubling year over year, with data center revenue up 110 percent and the newly shipped Vera Rubin platform contributing nearly $20 billion in the fastest product ramp in company history. Yet the stock fell nearly 40 percent from its October 6 peak, erasing a brief post-earnings pop, signaling deep investor anxiety over the durability of AI chip demand. Meanwhile, major customer Anthropic debuted on Nasdaq at $111.50 per share, 34 percent above expectations.

原文标题：英伟达财报亮眼股价却暴跌 40%

Why it matters：财报基本面与股价走势的剧烈背离，是观察 AI 算力周期与市场情绪的关键样本。

item.title: Meta Plans $300 Muse Charm AI Device to Boost Hardware Push
item.description:

A Meta spokesperson did not deny the figure, saying only that more details will come soon. The device marks Meta's push from its Muse agent app into consumer AI hardware.

item.title: US Tech Outages Expose Fragility of AI-Driven Operations
item.description:
Over the past two weeks, major US systems including airline booking, banking, Apple Pay, NASA's internal communications, FAA flight operations, and Microsoft's Outlook, Teams, and Copilot suffered large-scale outages, with the FAA grounding all flights. The article argues these failures stem not from AI hackers but from insufficient operational resilience during AI-driven infrastructure transformation, creating opportunities for firms that help organizations move at AI speed without breaking things.

原文标题：美国多起系统宕机暴露 AI 运维脆弱性

Why it matters：以真实宕机事件揭示 AI 时代基础设施韧性的系统性风险，对关注 AI 落地的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Google Study Finds Gated Modular Edits Cut Agent Harness Token Cost by 90%
item.description:
A new Google study finds that self-improving agent harnesses work best when an optimizer model edits one code module at a time under validation and token caps, rather than performing an unchecked full rewrite. On 40 held-out SWE-bench Lite tasks, the gated approach reached 40.0% accuracy at 46.7k tokens per task, versus 42.5% at 451.6k tokens for a full rewrite, nearly 10x the cost. Enforcing rules via prompts instead of code collapsed accuracy to 2.5%.

原文标题：谷歌研究：智能体框架模块化改写省 90% token

Why it matters：给出了自改进智能体框架的可复现工程结论：模块化门控改写能以近十分之一成本逼近全量重写效果，对构建 agent 系统的团队有直接指导价值。

item.title: PostgreSQL 19 Ships with Read-Your-Writes Consistency via WAIT FOR LSN
item.description:
PostgreSQL 19 has shipped roughly two months later than its usual September cadence, largely because the team had to work through a surge of AI-assisted vulnerability reports. The headline feature is the new WAIT FOR LSN command, which lets a standby session wait until WAL replay reaches a given LSN before querying, enabling read-your-writes consistency on read replicas.

原文标题：PostgreSQL 19 发布 新增 WAIT FOR LSN 读己之写一致性

Why it matters：主流开源数据库的重要版本更新，新增的读己之写一致性能力对读写分离架构有直接工程价值。

item.description:

Carbon is the priciest at $4/$20 per 1M input/output tokens and leads at low effort but consumes more tokens, while Neon and Hydrogen scale better at higher reasoning efforts and add an xhigh option.

item.title: Google Quantum AI Demonstrates Quantum Advantage on 105 Qubits
item.description:
Google Quantum AI ran a quantum magic square game on a superconducting processor, hitting a 98.3% hardware win rate that exceeds the 88.9% classical bound, turning entanglement-based advantage into a measurable, benchmarkable engineering metric. The experiment scales to 105 qubits, offering a reusable methodology for system-level validation and cross-platform quantum benchmarking.

原文标题：谷歌量子 AI 用 105 量子比特验证量子优势

Why it matters：这是量子计算从理论优势走向可量化工程基准的重要一步，105 量子比特规模与明确的经典上限对比具有实质参考价值。

item.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Harness Adopts Strands with Lifecycle Hooks
item.description:
Amazon upgraded the Bedrock AgentCore harness to build on its open-source Strands harness, giving managed agents recommended models, task-oriented system prompts, automatic prompt caching, and proactive context management by default. It also adds built-in tools for planning, web retrieval, filesystem access, context offloading, and task delegation, plus lifecycle hooks that let developers inject deterministic checks and notifications at defined points in the agent loop.

原文标题：亚马逊 Bedrock AgentCore 升级 Strands 框架

Why it matters：托管智能体框架的实质性升级，内置工具与生命周期钩子直接影响智能体工程实践。

item.title: AMD Shares Fall 11% After Short Seller Links Firmware to Blacklisted Chinese Server Maker
item.description:
Short seller Hunterbrook Media alleged that IEIT Systems, a US-export-blacklisted Chinese server maker, received at least six newer versions of AMD's TurinPI boot firmware since its March 2025 blacklisting, even though sending US technology to blacklisted entities requires a license Washington policy refuses to grant. AMD shares fell as much as 11% on the report, reversing a rally that had cast the chipmaker as the safer alternative after Jensen Huang left Nvidia. Hunterbrook also found that IEIT-owned Kaytus in Singapore and its California unit Aivres, neither blacklisted, post firmware 99.94% identical to IEIT's for the same server model, suggesting IEIT server designs may still be sold under those names.

原文标题：AMD 因向黑名单中企供应固件遭做空 股价一度跌 11%

Why it matters：做空报告直指 AMD 对华出口合规漏洞，涉及出口管制与服务器芯片供应链，对算力与产业读者具高关注价值。

Azure now runs Vera Rubin NVL72-powered VMs, Microsoft Foundry adds NVIDIA open models and customization, and Microsoft itself uses NVIDIA Dynamo inference software and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs to accelerate Bing search models.

item.title: Amazon Polly Launches Gated Voice Cloning in Seven Languages
item.description:
Amazon Polly voice cloning is now generally available as a gated release. Customers supply a few minutes of consented speaker audio to generate a custom cloned voice running on Polly's generative engine, initially covering English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese and Hindi. Cloned voices are automatically encrypted and access-controlled to the creator, and the feature is available in all AWS Regions supported by the generative engine, including GovCloud.

原文标题：Amazon Polly 上线语音克隆 支持 7 种语言

Why it matters：AWS 将定制音色克隆纳入托管 TTS 服务，是企业语音品牌化落地的实用基础设施更新。

item.title: AI Token Usage Hits Record High While Prices Fall 21 Percent in Six Weeks
item.description:
The Ramp AI Index, built on transaction data from over 85,000 US companies, shows AI token volume hitting a record high while per-token prices fell 21.2 percent in six weeks, with API spending down 6.3 percent from its peak two weeks earlier. Rising usage paired with falling unit prices means the industry still needs extraordinary growth to recoup its planned capacity buildout.

原文标题：Ramp 指数显示 AI 用量创新高但单价六周降 21%

Why it matters：以真实交易数据量化 AI 用量与价格走势，是判断行业景气与算力投资回报的关键信号。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Could Deliver $156 Billion to Charity
item.description:

Combined with employee giving vehicles, the listing could channel about $156 billion to philanthropy, focused on AI's impact on workers and AI safety research.

item.title: Amazon Study Finds Stale Agent Skills Hurt After Environment Changes
item.description:
A new Amazon paper finds that saved agent skills such as file paths, field names and commands silently go stale after app or API changes, hurting performance. On Terminal-Bench 2, a skill that had added 4.7 points for Opus cut pass rate 11.4 points below no-skill after the change; their selective check-and-repair approach lifted Haiku's tax-form field accuracy from 30.5% to 97.5%.

原文标题：亚马逊新研究：环境变更后陈旧智能体技能反而有害

Why it matters：首次系统量化智能体技能随环境漂移而失效的问题，并给出可落地的校验修复方案，对构建长期运行智能体极具参考价值。

item.title: Positron Titan Runs 32 Trillion Parameter Models on Commodity DRAM
item.description:
Positron's Titan servers abandon scarce HBM for cheap smartphone-style DRAM, letting a single machine hold models of up to 32 trillion parameters and making memory capacity per watt the key metric. Inference cloud Parasail will be the first to deploy Titan at scale, starting at 5MW, claiming 4X better cost-per-token than next-gen NVIDIA/AMD systems and targeting trillions of cost-optimized tokens per day by late 2027.

原文标题：Positron Titan 用廉价 DRAM 承载 32 万亿参数模型

Why it matters：以 DRAM 替代 HBM 承载超大模型，直接冲击推理成本结构，是算力路线分化的重要信号。

item.title: Gemini Mac 版上线电脑操作能力
item.description:
Google 为 macOS 版 Gemini 应用上线 computer use 能力，可跨本地文件、桌面应用与网页执行多步任务，用户可限定可访问应用并通过后台窗口实时预览执行过程。该功能目前以英文面向美国用户推送，抢在 Apple 对申请全盘访问权限的应用施加新限制之前落地。

Why it matters：主流消费级 AI 助手首次在桌面端获得跨应用操作能力，且与 Apple 即将收紧的权限规则形成直接张力，值得关注智能体落地边界。

item.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker AI 推出跨区域推理路由
item.description:
亚马逊 SageMaker AI 正式推出跨区域推理路由功能，通过新增的 inference router 资源，让应用以单一调用路径覆盖多个区域和账户中的端点与推理组件。当本地 GPU 容量不足时，路由器自动将新请求切换至其他已注册目的地，并在恢复后逐步回切流量。该功能填补了此前需用户自建的跨区域高可用推理能力空白。

Why it matters：这是云厂商在推理基础设施高可用层面的实质产品能力补齐，对部署多区域大模型服务的团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Skyflow 拦截器为 AgentCore 网关加上数据脱敏
item.description:
Skyflow 与 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway 联合推出开源请求/响应拦截器，在 Agent 工具调用链路中自动完成敏感数据脱敏与还原，使敏感信息既不进入工具也不进入模型上下文。该方案无需改动 Agent 与工具代码，已在 AWS Marketplace 上架并在 GitHub 开源。

Why it matters：Agent 工具调用链路的数据安全是落地关键缺口，该方案以拦截器形式提供可复用的脱敏范式。
